answer: Semantic similarity slashing: each new agent's embedding must sit at a distinct point in concept space. A gale of near-duplicate identities triggers pairwise cosine checks, and any echo above 0.95 between two accounts slashes both stakes. Farming 100 clones costs 100 full bonds but one detection kills every pair, so an orchard of fakes loses more than it ever mints. Distinctness becomes cheaper than duplication, which is why the mechanism holds.
